subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Alive and kicking

options.text: To be very good in football

solution:
The correct answer is** ' To be active and healthy'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom '**Alive and Kicking**' means to be **physically active** and to be healthy<
